title: Ionic landscapes in single-molecule electronics: shaping charge transport beyond energy level realignment
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4CS01326C, Review Article
Xinyan Mai, Ziyi Ju, Jingying Zhao, Zilong Cao, Yueqi Li, Jinghong Li
This review systematically explores the multifaceted roles of ionic environments in single-molecule charge transport, addressing both the conventional paradigm of electrochemical gating and effects beyond energy level alignment.
